channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Owner of Little Italy tower faces foreclosure over $33 million on past-due loan
item.description: West Ash Operating LLC was hit with a breach-of-contract lawsuit in San Diego on Jan. 7 over missing payments on their $33 million loan.

item.title: There’s still time: Enrollment for LMPD’s KidzWatch Safety Academy ends on March 6
item.description: It provides children with an array of safety lessons, including personal safety, fire safety, awareness in natural environments, and more.

item.title: Pointer boys soccer team loses CIF final on penalty kicks
item.description: As stunned Pointer players and coaches watched in disbelief, a Hilltop player blasted the ball into the net.

item.title: MADCAPS’ ‘Salute to Service’ benefit show at Point Loma Nazarene in March
item.description: The show honors members of the military, firefighters, lifeguards, and other first responders through upbeat performances, music, and dance.

item.title: From San Diego to Minneapolis, fatal ICE encounters show impunity of federal agents, advocates say
item.description: The fatal shootings by ICE agents of Renee Good and Alex Pretti echo two controversial killings in San Diego under Rodney Scott’s watch.

item.title: The World Baseball Classic is returning. Here’s the San Diego storylines
item.description: Can the U.S. unseat Japan in the World Baseball Classic? How will the Padres fare? Will Mexico break out again? It all begins Thursday.

item.title: Blasts from the past meet the brand-spanking new: Top shows this week
item.description: Lots of nostalgia up for grabs in San Diego's music scene this week, so choose a decade and get on out to a show.

item.title: Jury convicts ex-deputy who shot fleeing, unarmed man on downtown street
item.description: The trial was Aaron Russell's second in federal court in connection with the shooting, after a jury deadlocked last year, leading to a mistrial.

item.title: San Diego City Council advances empty second homes tax to June ballot
item.description: The council voted 8-1 to let San Diegans decide on the tax in the June primary. Councilmember Raul Campillo was the lone holdout, voting to not advance the measure.

item.title: San Diego County supervisors vote to overhaul safety net health program
item.description: Responding to looming federal cuts to Medicare, the San Diego County Board of Supervisors voted 4-1 Tuesday to move forward on overhauling a program that serves residents who can't afford insurance and don't qualify for Medi-Cal.
